accessNotes: The Data Visualization page (Overview/Guidance, Color & Typography, Types & Usage, Infographics, Accessibility) was read in full via curl (server-rendered AEM page) and example images downloaded. The per-chart 'DESIGN SPECS' (donut, pie, bar, horizontal bar, stacked bar, line, area, plot) are hosted as Adobe XD share links that are JS-only and could not be read, so exact px specs for axes, gridlines and type sizes are unavailable; structural details below come from the example images. The site now carries a banner that MetLife is evolving its brand and Brand Central (brand.metlife.com) is the new source of truth.
summary: MetLife's product/marketing design system treats charts as bold, simple, brand-coloured graphics inside white dashboard cards: MetLife Circular for headers and key numbers, Noto Sans for labels/legends/source, a primary palette of MetLife blue #0090DA, green #A4CE4E, purple #5F259F, teal #00ACA0 and yellow #FFC600 anchored by black, dotted light-grey gridlines and small square-swatch legends. Guidance favours big standalone numbers, focus on one takeaway, and simple chart types sized to the screen.

colors.categoricalNotes: Palette 2 (Extended) in the prescribed datapoint order 1–15 – 'use colors from the pallet in provided order as they have enough contrast ratio between them'. Don't use all colours; ensure contrast between adjacent colours; black/white (and #333333/#f2f2f2) swap depending on light/dark background. Palette 1 (Basic, base palette with accents): Green #A4CE4E, Blue 1 #0090DA, White #FFFFFF, Black #000000, Purple #5F259F, Teal #00ACA0, Yellow #FFC600. Examples use blue then green for two-series lines, and blue/purple/grey for three groups.
colors.notes: 'Use black as an anchoring color to convey expertise.' Never place charts on busy backgrounds/photos (shown as a Don't). Must meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast.

typography.family: MetLife Circular (headers, sub-headers, highlighted key data points); Noto Sans (labels, legends, descriptions, source)

dataLabel.weight: large MetLife Circular numerals for key values

typography.notes: Follow the page's typography hierarchy; use font weight and body-copy sizes to build hierarchy; label text must not be too small. 'Enlarging numbers by themselves can be an interesting way to represent data.' Card headings in examples are preceded by a short blue-to-green gradient rule.

structure.gridlines: Horizontal only, dotted light grey (line-chart example); horizontal bars sit on thin grey full-length track lines instead of gridlines.
structure.axisLine: Thin dark x- and y-axis lines in the line-chart example.
structure.ticks: Small ticks at labelled dates on the x-axis.
structure.frame: White card container with subtle shadow on a light-grey page; card title top-left.
structure.notes: Time-range toggles (1 yr / 3 yr / 5 yr) as underlined tabs above the chart, with a green-ringed help '?' icon.

legend.placement: below the chart, centred (line chart); above the chart, left-aligned in a row (bar list)
legend.directLabels: Values printed at bar ends; donut centre shows 'Total 100%'.
legend.title: none
legend.notes: Legend text in small Noto Sans.

marks.bars: Thin horizontal bars on a light grey full-width track line, category label above each bar, large percentage value to the right of the track; bar charts best with ≤6 points on small screens and 15–20 on wide screens.
marks.pies: Pie/donut for single-series part-to-whole in small spaces (dashboard cards, mobile); donut with total in the centre; slices start at 12 o'clock clockwise, no gaps; empty donut state is a light grey ring.
marks.notes: Guide: pie when the single series is all positive; donut when it includes negative values.

labels.dataLabels: Key values large at bar ends; tooltips, symbols and annotations used so colour isn't the only carrier.
labels.dates: Abbreviated month + year ('Jul 2019'); dd/mm/yyyy in 'as of' notes.

furniture.title: Card header in MetLife Circular, top-left, preceded by a short gradient rule; chart sub-header in uppercase small caps-style ('HISTORICAL PERFORMANCE:').
furniture.source: Source line in Noto Sans (no pattern given).
furniture.other: Infographic components: Data Insight, Display Key Insights, Key Stat Breaker, Trend Spotting.

annotations: Annotations allowed as non-colour information carriers; no styling spec.
layout: Simple data (pie/donut) for small/medium spaces; bar/column for any size; line/area/plot for large screens. Responsive: scrollable containers, collapsing sections or reduced data on mobile.
interaction: Keyboard-accessible interactions; 'Try to avoid animation and hover states'; tooltips as supplementary info.
accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA; provide data table/RTF alternative; use palette in given order for adjacent contrast; never rely on colour alone; readable label sizes; text descriptions for novel charts.

discouraged: charts over photos or busy backgrounds

distinctiveRules.rule: Assign series colours in the fixed extended order: #0090DA, #333333, #00ACA0, #DB0A5B, #F2F2F2, #007ABC, #A4CE4E, #6E6E6E, #FFC600, #5F259F, #A7A8AA, #0061A0, #BADDF5, #528320, #D42123.
distinctiveRules.quote: make sure to use colors from the pallet in provided order as they have enough contrast ratio between them

distinctiveRules.rule: Headers and key numbers in MetLife Circular; all labels, legends, descriptions and source in Noto Sans.
distinctiveRules.quote: Use Noto Sans in your data visualization for labels, legends, descriptions, source etc.

distinctiveRules.rule: Be bold: primary palette graphic shapes, black as anchor colour, and enlarged standalone numbers for the key figure.
distinctiveRules.quote: Use bold, graphic shapes and the primary color palette … Use black as an anchoring color

distinctiveRules.rule: Never place charts over photos or busy backgrounds; use white/light cards.
distinctiveRules.quote: Don't Use data visualizations in front of busy backgrounds.

distinctiveRules.rule: Line charts: dotted light-grey horizontal gridlines, $-formatted y ticks, abbreviated month-year x labels, square-swatch legend centred below.
Horizontal bar lists: label above each bar, bar on a thin grey full-length track, large % value right of the track, legend row top-left.
Donuts show 'Total N%' in the centre; empty state is a solid light-grey ring.
Bar charts: ≤6 data points on small screens, 15–20 on wide screens.
distinctiveRules.quote: For a wider screen, number of data points between 15-20 is preferred, while on a smaller screen 6 data points

distinctiveRules.rule: Avoid animation and hover-dependent states; interactions must be keyboard accessible.
distinctiveRules.quote: Try to avoid animation and hover states.

distinctiveRules.rule: Charts live in white shadowed cards whose title is preceded by a short blue→green gradient rule.

referenceImages.describes: Dashboard card 'Your Performance' (white card with soft shadow, title in MetLife Circular preceded by a short blue-green rule; 'Manage My Funds' link top-right in blue). Left: 'TOTAL ACCOUNT VALUE:' uppercase label over a huge bold '$38,752.11' and a list of metrics with thin dividers. Right: 'HISTORICAL PERFORMANCE:' uppercase with 1 yr/3 yr/5 yr underline tabs. Line chart: two ~2px lines, blue #0090DA (Account Value) and green #A4CE4E (Premium), no markers; dotted light-grey horizontal gridlines; y labels $10,000–$50,000 small dark grey at left; thin dark y and x axis lines; x labels Jul 2019 / Nov 2019 / Mar 2020 with small ticks; square-swatch legend centred below.

Horizontal bar list on white: legend row top-left with small squares (blue, purple, grey age groups). Each item: category label in regular dark sans above, then a thick short bar (blue #0090DA-ish, purple #5F259F, or grey) sitting on a thin light-grey track line to a fixed length, with a large black percentage (54%, 32% …) to the right. No axes, no gridlines, no title in plot.

'Manage My Funds' modal: two donuts with uppercase headings ('NEW ALLOCATION', 'CURRENT ALLOCATION'). Empty donut is a light-grey ring with 'Total 0%' centred; filled donut with segments in dark blue, mid blue, light blue, green, purple, yellow starting at 12 o'clock, no gaps, 'Total 100%' in the centre. Adjacent table rows carry a coloured left edge bar matching each fund's donut colour.
